remarks: Great Location in central Westport directly on Post Road East. High visibility for your business with 65 feet of Post Road Frontage and vehicle count per day exceeding 23,000. This flexible office space is perfect for a variety of business types with plenty of parking for staff and visitors. The space is the entire second floor and/or third floors of the building with approximately 900 of open plan square feet. The space contains its own rest room and kitchenette area for the convenience of tenant. Security system is in place and all utilities are included.
